decisions.share: copy file, drag and drop, in-app player
decisions.layout: clips: list + player side by side

tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Window background. The value is the bottom stop of the app icon's tile.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Panels, clip rows and setting groups laid on surface-0.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed rows, inputs, secondary buttons, Kbd keys. The value is the top stop of the app icon's tile.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and around panels. Decorative only; never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control edges (switch track off, slider rail, input border). At least 3:1 on surface-0 and surface-1.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface-0, surface-1 and surface-2.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (sizes, dates, helper lines) on surface-0, surface-1 and surface-2.

tokens.name: rec
tokens.usage: The record dot: brand mark and the live-buffer indicator. Shapes only, never text (4.27:1 on dark surface-0).

tokens.name: rec-fill
tokens.usage: Primary button fill (one per view, the main action). Text on it: on-rec.

tokens.name: rec-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and pressed.

tokens.name: on-rec
tokens.usage: Text and icons on rec-fill (5.62:1).

tokens.name: rec-text
tokens.usage: Error text (invalid hotkey, no screen), on surface-0, surface-1 and surface-2. Always paired with a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: ok-text
tokens.usage: The check icon of a confirmation toast, on surface-0 and surface-1. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, 2px offset, on every interactive element. Solid; same value as ink so it holds on every surface.

tokens.name: tile
tokens.usage: App icon tile and clip thumbnail placeholder, behind the in-app player.

tokens.name: tile-deep
tokens.usage: Duration chip on a thumbnail; bottom stop of the app icon tile.

tokens.name: tile-ink
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on tile and tile-deep (the icon's replay arrow colour).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind the play glyph on a hovered thumbnail, and behind a Dialog.

families.ui: "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
families.display: "Segoe UI Variable Display", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Helper lines, clip metadata, in ink-muted.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: File names, paths, hotkeys inside Kbd.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: Duration chip on thumbnails, in tile-ink on tile-deep.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, Kbd padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons; padding inside chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding inside clip items and setting rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gap between rows groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Window gutter around the content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between major sections; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Kbd keys, duration chip, focus ring corners on small controls.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segmented control, thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels and the window itself (Windows 11 corner).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Record dot, switch track and thumb.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, inputs and the segmented control.

tokens.name: thumb-w
tokens.usage: Clip thumbnail width in the library list (16:9, 54px high).

tokens.name: window-w
tokens.usage: Default window width; minimum 720px.

tokens.name: list-w
tokens.usage: Width of the clip list beside the player.
